book.name: Yohane
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Yohane

content: Yecho na mwikeghe Nsamaliya
Mapwalichayo bhakajhohine Yecho akwete bhando bhamahele kubhehe bhabholwa na kubaticha kupeta Yohane.
Nambo Yecho jwenio akabatiche ndeka bhando, nambo bhabholwa bhake ndi bhakabatiche bhando.
Bhahe, Yecho pajhohina gheniya, ajhakubhoka ku Yudeya na kubhujha ku Galilaya.
Mu mwanja gwake impalita apetele ku Samaliya.
Bhahe, ajhakuhika ku muche gwa ku Samaliya, ghuukemwa Sukale, ghuheghelile na nng'onda ghola gwa Yakobu gwakampekiye mwana mundo jwakemwita Uchupo.
Peniya pakibha na kilibha cha Yakobu, na Yecho nhwalo gwa kutotokela kwa mwanja, ajhakutama pahina jha kilibha. Ikibha chaa chita jha muhe.
Bhahe, mwikeghe jhumo Nsamaliya ajhakuhika kuteka mache. Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Nijhopa mache nyweghe.”
Yecho akibha kanjika, bhabholwa bhake pubhajhahwile kubomane kuheme ilebhe ya kulyegha.
Mwikeghe jhola ajhakunnobholela Yecho, “Mwenga ma Yahude na nenga ndi Nasamaliya. Nhwalo ghane unyopa mache gha kunywegha?” Alongila naha nhwalo Akayahude na Akasamaliya bhilye ndeka pamonga.
Yecho ajhakunyanguu, “Anda ngaumanya hupo ya Chapanga na ndi ghane jwannyopa mache gha kunywegha, ngamunyopite na jwenio ngampekiye mache ghighaleta ughome.”
Mwikeghe jhola ajhakunnobholela, “Bhambo, nkwete jhe nteko gwa kuteke mache na kilibha kibhii nnyoli. Bho, ngoheno namughakolela kojhe mache ghighaleta ughome?
Amu pange mwenga mukitenda mwanahota kuliku tate gwito Yakobu? Jwenio akatupekii twenga kilibha chenje helahela na jwenio na yana mundo na inyama yake bhanywila mache gha kilibha chenje.”
Yecho ajhakunyanguu, “Jwanywegha mache ghanga najhohii jhe nyota kabhele.

Nambo jwapala kunywegha mache ghakumpekeya nenga, nabhe jhe na nyota kwa ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta. Mache ghunimpela kumpekiya ghunimpela nkate jhino naghabha chembwe cha mache ghighaleta ughome na kumpela ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta.”
Mwikeghe jhola ajhakunnobholela, “Bhambo, umbekehe mache gheniya! Ngotoka kubhehe na nyota kabhele, na ngotoka kuhika kabhele kuteka mache pamba.”
Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Nnyende mukankeme ungana gwino, na nhwike nako pamba.”
Jwenio mwikeghe ajhakunnobholela, “Nenga ndoline jhe.” Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Unywagwii mbone, nkwete ndeka munalome.
Nhwalo mukibha na akanalome nhwano na munalome jhutama nako ngoheno jwii ndeka. Chakaka nnongii maha.”
Bhahe, mwikeghe jhola ajhakunnobholela, “Bhambo, nibhona mwenga ndi ma nondole bha Chapanga.
Akahoko bhito bhanyinamila Chapanga pakitombe chenje, nambo mangota Akayahude milongela ku Yeluchalemo ndi kwa kunyope Chapanga.”
Yecho ajhakunyanguu, “Mwe majhe unyeketele chinilonge, machiko ghabhii kuhika bhando nabhanyinamila ndeka Tate panane jha kitombe chenje amu kola ku Yeluchalemo.
Mangota mwaka Samaliya, munyinamila Chapanga jhola jwangaumanya, nambo twenga Akayahude tunyinamila Chapanga jhutummanye, nhwalo gwa ughombokeko uhumii kwa Akayahude.

Nambo machiko ghabhii kuhika, kabhele ghahikite, bhibhanyinamila Chapanga jwa uchakaka na bhanyopa Tate kuhumii muhuke gwa Chapanga na uchakaka. Nhwalo Tate abhapala bhando ngita bheniya bhannyinamile.
Chapanga ndi Uhuke na bhando bhibhanyopa ibhapala bhanyinamila Chapanga kwa kulongochwa na Uhuke gwa Chapanga na uchakaka.”
Mwikeghe jhola ajhakunnobholela, “Nimanya Machiya Nkomboche, jhuikemwa Kilichitu abhii kuhika. Papala kuhika na natulobholela hotuhotu kila kilebhe.”
Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Nenga jhunilongela na mwenga, ndi nenga.”

Papa bhabholwa bhake bhajhakubhujha, bhajhakukangacha hake kubhona akilongela na mwikeghe jhola. Nambo abhii jhe mundo jwakankonyite, “Mipala nike?” Amu “Nhwalo gwa nike milongela na mwikeghe jwenio?”
Bhahe, mwikeghe jhola ajhakuuleka nkambo ghola papa na kubhujha kubomane kwalongelela bhando,
“Tijha mukanole mundo jwanobholile ilebhe yoha indehila. Bho, pange ihoto kubhehe jwenio ndi Kilichitu Nkomboche?”
Bhahe, bhando bhajhakubhoka ku bomane nu kujhenda kunninga Yecho.
Muda ghogho bhabholwa bhake bhampembelikiya Yecho bhalongila, “Mmola, nlyeghe!”
Nambo Yecho ajhakujhanguu, “Nenga ngwete cha kulyegha mangota mukimanyitii jhe.”
Bhahe, bhabholwa bhake bhajhakukonyana, “Bho, abhii mundo jwannetile chakulyegha?”
Yecho ajhakwalobholela, “Chinilyegha ndi kuhenga ghapala jhola jwandumita na kujhomola lihengo lyambekii kuhenga.
Mangota mulonge, ‘Jhamela miyehe ncheche tugha, na mahuno naghatumbula.’ Nambo ninnobholela, dolokeya mighonda chilenganikilwe kwa mahuno.
Mundo jwahuna alepitwe njwe malepo ghake na jwaponga mahuno kwa nhwalo jha ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta, hele jwamicha na jwahuna nabhahangana pamonga.
Nhwalo luhumo londo chakaka ‘Mundo jhumo umicha na mundo jhonge jwakuhuna.’
Nenga nitumingine mukahune mu mighonda jhangalema, bhando bhange bhakahengite lihengo, nambo mangota mwenga minong'omenekeya kwa lihengo lyabhe.”
Akasamaliya twe bha ku bomane jhela ngabhanyeketila Yecho kwa nhwalo gwa majhe jhola, “Anobholile ilebhe yoha indehila.”
Bhahe, Akasamaliya bhajhakunyendelela Yecho, bhajhakunnyopa bhatame nako, na jwenio ajhakutama kwa machiko mabhele.
Bhando bhamahele bhajhakunnyeketela Yecho nhwalo gwa malobhe ghala ghalongila.

Bhajhakunnobholela majhe jhola, “Twenga ngoheno tujheketile, chi kwa nhwalo kwa chela chinongela, nambo nhwalo twabhete tujhohine na tumanya mundo jhonjo chakaka Nchengula jwa bhando bhoha bha pannema.”
Yecho inamicha mwana jwa munahota
Pighapetita machiko mabhele Yecho ajhakubhoka kwenio, na kujhenda ku Galilaya.
Nhwalo Yecho jwenio alongila hotuhotu, “Nnondole jwa Chapanga ilendemwa ndeka ku kilambo chabhelukilwe.”
Bhahe, pahikita ku Galilaya, bhando bhamahele bhajhakumpokela nhwalo bhene bhakajhenda ku Unyagho gwa Pachaka kwenio ku Yeluchalemo, na bhakaihwene yoha yatehila Yecho pa unyagho gwenio.

Yecho pajhahwila kabhele ku Kana ghubhii ku muche gwa ku Galilaya, kwenio kwaghalambwiya mache kubhehe divaye. Kwenio pakibha na munahota jhumo mwana mundo atehila kulwalwa ku muche gwa ku Kapelenaumo.
Bhahe, munahota jwenio pajhohina Yecho ahikite ku Galilaya kuhumii ku Yudeya ajhakunnyendelela na kunnyopa anamiche mwana mundo jwakibha tepekatepeka.
Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Mangota bhando changalola nginyililo na ikangacho minyekete jhe Chapanga.”
Munahota jwenio ajhakunnobholela, “Bhambo, chonde tujhende mwanango kabula jha kuwegha.”
Yecho ajhakunnobholela, “Nnyende tugha mwana gwino nabhaha ghome!” Mundo jhola ajhakujheketela malobhe gha Yecho, ajhakujhenda.
Munahota jhola pakibha undela kubhujha, akatumiche bhake ajhakukongana nako na kunnobholela mwana gwino abhii ghome njwe.
Na jwenio ajhakwakonya muda ghane patumbwila kubhehe mbaha, na bhene ngabhanyangwila, “Dicho cha chaba jha muhe punekikiya ulwalo.”
Tate jhola ajhakukomboka lichaa lelelalela pannobholila Yecho, “Mwana gwino amela ghome.” Bhahe, jwenio na nyumba jhake jhoha bhajhakunyeketela Yecho.
Ikibha nginyililo jhubhele jha kukangacha jhatehila Yecho pahumita ku Yudeya na kujhenda ku Galilaya.
